title: Per-account research asks the shared hub before paying for Place Details, and a revoked hub copy leaves its briefs
steps: S1: A standalone client with WO_SHARED_RESEARCH=0 and a hub that already published place A researches A.
S2: The hub removes the business; the client runs its hub tick and builds the brief research of its opportunity.
expect: S1: 0 Place Details calls; the brief research's googlePlace has the hub's name and via hub.
S2: the brief research has no googlePlace and hubRevoked of length 1.
evidence: Before: only the shared place path read the hub; per-account research always paid Google
fence: executor placeFacts calls hub.placeFacts before fetchPlaceDetails behind the hub dep; held hub facts and per-account briefs are checked against wo_hub_client_place.revoked_at

tests: per-account research reads the hub before paying for Place Details too
a business removed on the hub leaves the client cache
